sources.title: GitHub - Aamirofficiall/rag-playbook: Stop guessing which RAG pattern ...
sources.snippet: Every RAG tutorial teaches you how to build patterns. None of them tell you which one to actually use. rag-playbook runs the same query against 8 production-tested RAG patterns and shows you which one wins — with real numbers for quality, latency, and cost.

sources.title: Playbook RAG and Vector Store | ladislav-lettovsky/ai-delivery ...
sources.snippet: The RAG pipeline consists of a PDF extraction layer, a recursive text splitting strategy, a local embedding model, and a persistent ChromaDB vector store. Access to this data is abstracted through a LangChain-compatible retriever and exposed to agents via a specialized tool.
